remaining_differences: The GPT architecture looks flatter and more regular: the tower shaft uses shallow rectangular divisions instead of the ORIGINAL’s prominent dark recessed openings, and the adjoining building reads as a broad rectangular block. These differences persist through the supplied samples.

The ORIGINAL has stronger amber illumination, a conspicuously glowing clock face and warm pools of street-level light. GPT uses more even pale-gold surfaces and restrained clock glow, reducing the miniature’s luminous appearance.

The ORIGINAL platform is densely dressed with colorful fallen leaves, especially around its perimeter and roadway. GPT leaves much larger bare cream areas and has a cleaner, straighter-looking road treatment. The mismatch is especially clear during 0–2 seconds.

The ORIGINAL’s airborne leaves include larger, brighter yellow, orange and green shapes, with substantial clustering left of the tower and near the street. GPT shows finer, more subdued flecks concentrated in an upper cloud. Later samples retain this difference in particle scale, color and distribution.

The miniature reaches a different viewing angle. The ORIGINAL presents a more frontal single clock face and a narrower, receding right-hand building; GPT still exposes two clock faces and a broad building façade. The sampled orientation changes therefore do not align at the endpoint.

The ORIGINAL glass has broader, softer reflections and bright curved side highlights. GPT relies more on crisp diagonal streaks, including a conspicuous stripe beside the clock. The sphere’s size and transparency are otherwise close.

GPT’s phone has a darker, thicker-looking rim and a conspicuous left-side button, whereas the ORIGINAL emphasizes a thin silver perimeter. GPT’s background and screen also have a slightly cooler green-cyan cast.

differences.description: The GPT architecture has broad, flat ochre surfaces, simplified roof details and repetitive dark window slots. The reference has more articulated clock-stage trim, smaller architectural details and stronger dimensional shading. This difference persists across the samples.

The reference tower, clock and street area emit strong warm light, with bright clock faces and localized illumination around the building and lamps. GPT has much more uniform lighting and a comparatively dull miniature.

GPT presents a broad, relatively bare cream platform with a nearly straight foreground road. The reference has a more substantial dark platform edge, denser ground-level leaves and street detail, and a road layout that reads with greater depth.

The reference glass has a broad luminous upper-right reflection and stronger curved, layered highlights. GPT uses cleaner, narrower streaks and a more uniform rim. At 3 and 5.85 seconds, the reference again shows more substantial reflections crossing and wrapping around the miniature.

The reference contains many conspicuous yellow, orange, red and green airborne flecks across the left side, foreground and around the tower. GPT has a sparse, faint scattering concentrated near the building and rear of the platform. The density and depth mismatch remains evident at 4, 5 and 5.85 seconds.

The matched viewing angle differs: the reference exposes two bright clock faces and a clearly receding adjoining building, while GPT shows one dominant, nearly frontal clock face that appears dark. At 5.85 seconds, the reference tower sits farther right within the globe and exposes a different street arrangement than GPT.

The GPT phone has a broader, darker rim, a subtly green-black display and a visible protruding left-side button. The reference has a finer silver perimeter and a more neutral black screen, with its prominent button on the right.
